subject: Observability add-on commercial reframe & concession path — Brightline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ops Engineering <ops-eng@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Observability add-on commercial framing and next steps

Hi Maya / Brightline team —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation I pulled together a short commercial framing for the observability add-ons you asked about (retention extension, tracing high-cardinality, and the advanced dashboard pack). Attached is RetainTrace_Pricing_v2.pdf with three packaging options: Pilot, Scale, and Enterprise.

Quick summary:
- Pilot: 3-month, capped seatless retention + sampled traces (no SLA) — lowest entry price.
- Scale: 12-month commit with conservative discounting on storage; includes tracing at 2x sampling and the advanced dashboards module.
- Enterprise: 24-month commit, priority support, explicit SLA for trace ingestion and query latency.

Two asks from your side to finalize pricing:
1) Expected 12-month token/ingest profile (rough monthly delta vs today).
2) Which billing model you prefer: monthly meter vs slab pre-commit.

If procurement is inclined to push for one-time onboarding credit, we can discuss concession paths but will need a commitment horizon to match. Proposed next step: 30-minute call Tuesday to lock on a single option and draft SOW.

Attachments: RetainTrace_Pricing_v2.pdf (proposal), SOW-Brightline-draft.docx (template)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive\Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>, Ops Engineering <ops-eng@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability add-on commercial framing and next steps

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the proposal and the clear framing. A few points from our side before we schedule a follow-up:

1) Can Brightline get an introductory concession on the Scale option? Our procurement target is ~20% effective discount off list for year one given the projected volume.
2) We need clarification on the SLA in Enterprise: what are the penalties/remedies for sustained trace ingestion failures?
3) For the dashboards, can you confirm whether the advanced pack includes lookback analytics for 90 days or longer? Our analytics team is specifically looking at 180-day replay.

We can do a call next Wednesday afternoon. Procurement is looped for commercial constraints.

-Maya
Maya Singh
Director, Platform Engineering\Brightline Health
maya.singh@brightlinehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-12T10:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Observability add-on commercial framing and next steps

Laura / Naomi —

Quick internal note and recommended concession path before the call with Brightline:

1) Discounting: Brightline is asking ~20% off list for year one on Scale. We can offer 15% off list on a 12-month commit with a Q2 start and a usage floor equal to 60% of their current ingest. If they commit to a 24-month horizon we can bridge to 20% in year one + a modest onboarding credit (one-time) to cover migration of 90-day history.

2) SLA language: our Enterprise SLA already covers ingestion availability and query latency. For procurement negotiations we should be explicit about remedies: service credit up to 10% of monthly invoice for sustained ingestion degradation >72 hours, with an agreed runbook. Legal will need to mark up.

3) Dashboards: advanced pack supports 180-day lookback for dashboard storage in Scale and Enterprise (subject to retention bucket selected). Pilot is limited to 30 days sampling. Call talking points below: lead with Scale (most likely), present 24-month as concession lever, and push for a usage-floor to avoid back-and-forth.

I'll join the customer call and propose the commit concession. Naomi — can you prepare a short redline of the SLA wording and a one-pager showing cost delta between 12/24 month?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Commercials\Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@brightlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-14T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability add-on commercial framing and next steps

Maya / Brightline procurement —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short response and a counterproposal ahead of our Wednesday call: 

Counterproposal (Scale path, commercial):
- 12-month commit starting April 1 with a 15% effective discount off list for year one.
- Usage floor: 60% of current ingest baseline; true-ups quarterly.
- One-time onboarding credit: $12k applied against month 1 invoice to assist with migration of historical traces.
- Dashboards: advanced pack will include up to 180-day lookback for queries as part of Scale.
- SLA: we will include the ingestion/query SLA in the SOW. Remedy: service credit up to 10% of the affected monthly invoice for incidents >72 consecutive hours; runbook to be attached.

Concession levers we can move on call: extend to 20% off in year one in exchange for a 24-month commit and a firm usage-floor at 70%.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether procurement can accept the 15% / 12-month + $12k onboarding credit.
2) If yes, we'll send a clean SOW and redlined SLA before the call and schedule a 30-minute decision call on Wednesday 2028-03-21 at 13:00 PT.

I've attached an updated pricing PDF and a draft SOW (SOW-Brightline-draft.docx) for review. Ben / Naomi / Jordan will be on the call.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive\Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
